claims_evidence.claim: The prototype documents 1–10 distinct bounty acceptance criteria.
The prototype documents criteria snapshots and a per-criterion review with written rationale.
The prototype documents accepted-work XP, but does not independently validate XP as a skill measure.
Paid bounty entries are listings, not in-app payout processing.

scenes.title: Useful work needs clear expectations
scenes.body: A task title is not enough. Contributors and owners need an inspectable definition of done.

scenes.title: Define the acceptance criteria
scenes.body: The prototype's documented contract allows one to ten distinct criteria for a bounty.

scenes.title: Submit against the agreed target
scenes.body: The source README documents a preserved snapshot of the criteria used for review.

scenes.title: Review every criterion
scenes.body: The documented acceptance protocol requires a pass or fail for each criterion and written rationale.

scenes.title: Improve work without losing context
scenes.body: The documented workflow supports requests for changes, resubmission, and retained review history.

scenes.title: Keep XP in its proper place
scenes.body: Acceptance currently grants platform XP. It is not an independently validated measure of skill.

scenes.title: Know what the prototype does not do
scenes.body: Paid bounty entries are listings. The app does not implement escrow, payment processing, or guaranteed payouts.

scenes.title: Inspect the workflow. Report the gaps.
scenes.body: Concept draft based on repository documentation. Live owner/contributor walkthrough and publication approval remain outstanding.
